scope: Local screening; no microphone/UI, SOTA comparison, model training, or hardware-general qualification. Cohere was selected as product default by the user.

definitions.streaming: Whole public source PCM replayed incrementally in non-overlapping 20ms packets against cumulative wall-clock deadlines; first packet is enqueued before its first20ms pacing wait.
definitions.firstPartialMs: From before synchronous stream startup/model initialization to first nonempty interim result; includes source leading silence and native lookahead.
definitions.stopToFinalMs: From after the last paced packet to finish/drain return; excludes cleanup, microphone/device stop, archive and UI.
definitions.streamingAsrMs: Paced request wall time including setup, finish and post-run partial observer scoring; not compute-only time or compute RTF.
definitions.offlineAsrMs: Completed-file InferenceManager call including verification/loading on cache misses, excluding source SHA checking and audio decoding/setup. Cohere is per-job; Nemotron weights are resident after the first sample.
definitions.cleanupMs: InferenceManager rewrite call; includes first model verification/load and later resident rewrites. Guard rejection remains an error and raw ASR stays available.
definitions.partialEditDistance: Sum of normalized word edit distances between adjacent visible nonempty updates, including appended words. Not a revision-only stability ratio.
definitions.rss: Whole benchmark process peak; includes complete source PCM, native pools and retained full partial transcript history. Not native KV/cache-only usage.

notMeasured: separate queue occupancy/drop counters (push failures are retained as errors)
